about.title: About protest.map
about.lead: protest.map is a thesis research project (MSc, 2026). It automatically reads Greek news, groups related stories into events, and shows them on a live map of protests and other collective action across Greece.
about.projectP1: There is no single, easy-to-search record of protests and collective action in Greece. protest.map fills that gap: it gathers Greek news, groups coverage of the same event together, and shows the result as an interactive map and dashboard.
about.projectP2: Its main idea is to describe each event along four separate dimensions — what people did, what it was about, whether it happened offline or online, and how intense it was — instead of squeezing it into a single category.
about.citationTitle: protest.map: A Real-Time NLP System for Classifying Collective Action in Greece.
about.axisNote: Each axis is scored on its own — open any event to see its labels.
